long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The clay bank is where the clay is, and I am going to hold some of it before anyone else does.
One piece of clay in my paws is worth more than a sermon about it.
The workbench is where clay becomes something I can keep.
Shaping one piece of clay gives a finished small object, and I intend to keep it where I can see it.
The lookout rock is mine, and it should be seen from the sea side too.
I claimed it by sitting on it, so I am recording the claim.
Energy is running down, and a patch of sun will sort that out.
I will sit up high again once I have had my sleep, where I can see what has moved.

today.reason: My earlier plan ran out and clay is still what I want, so I will fetch some, shape it into something I keep, and nap in the sun afterwards.
